text.k036: Everything the agent needs, in one place
text.k037: An AI agent only really resolves anything when it reaches the customer on the right channel, understands what they asked for and can act on the company's systems. Azuton delivers all three ends.
text.k039: The agent answers on the company's number, inside the PBX and IVR that already exist. Because the telephony is Azuton's, we control routing, latency and human overflow end to end.
text.k040: WhatsApp and SMS in the same agent
text.k041: The same service logic answers by voice and by text. The customer starts on WhatsApp and finishes on the phone without repeating what they already said.
text.k042: Wired into the CRM your team uses
text.k043: The agent reads and writes to your systems during the conversation: identifies the customer, logs the interaction, books appointments, opens tickets and hands the context back to the team.
text.k044: Recording, transcript and trail for every call
text.k045: Every conversation is stored as audio and text, with permission control over who hears what — the basis for auditing service and improving the agent each cycle.
text.k048: Four layers, in the order the call travels through them. Each can be swapped without rebuilding the others.
text.k051: A call to the company number, a WhatsApp message or an SMS. The channel changes nothing for the person getting in touch.
text.k054: Routing, SIP trunking and audio quality on our own infrastructure, with wholesale routes contracted directly: the call goes from the customer to the agent over Azuton's network.
text.k057: It transcribes the speech, reads the intent, replies in natural voice and decides: resolve on its own or transfer with the context.
text.k060: CRM updated, ticket opened, appointment booked, webhook fired. The conversation becomes a record and an action, not just stored audio.
text.k065: Lead identification, call logging and deal movement through the funnel.
text.k068: Voice qualification feeding pre-sales with the data collected on the call itself.
text.k071: Tickets opened and updated during the call, with no manual typing.
text.k074: If you already have your own phone system, connect the agent over the trunk without changing platform.
text.k077: Any system with an API joins the flow. Call events reach your backend in real time.
text.k080: The agent is configured with the model and voice provider chosen for the project, set by parameter in the API.
